text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Hatsune has made her way to Landosol
to deliver goods from Forestier to the Menagerie
...Or so she was supposed to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネは【フォレスティエ】と【動物苑】の交易品に関する仕事で、
ランドソルに訪れている……はずだった。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Not good, not good! I'm never gonna make it!
Not unless I resort to drastic measures...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメだぁ～！
　もう絶対間に合わない～！
こうなったら……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
No one's around, right?
Sha-shing! ☆ Miracle Teleport!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……誰もいない……よね？
きらーんっ☆
　ミラクルテレポート！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Touchdown, baby! Now to sprint!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルにとうちゃーく！
　
あとはダーッシュ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hello! I've got a delivery here!
*huff, huff* I made it on time... right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちはー！
　お届け物でーす！
はぁ……
はぁ……
間に合った……
よね？

text_block_list.name: Menagerie Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Right on time.
Let's run a quick check on the goods.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
約束の時間通りだよ。
それじゃあ早速検品しようか。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Okay. But first, I kind of need to...
Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい……
ごめんなさい、
その前にちょっとだけ……
……すやすや……

text_block_list.name: Menagerie Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm never not surprised by how much she sleeps.
Hey, Hatsune! Get up!
I did the checks, and everything matches up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いつもながらよく寝る子だよ。
おーい。ハツネちゃーん。
そろそろ起きろー
交易品の数はちゃんと書類通りだったよー

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
The... checks...? Oh!
For real? Now that's a relief!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こう……
えき……
ハッ！
本当に？
　
間違ってなくてよかったー！

text_block_list.name: Menagerie Staff
text_block_list.text:
Our members tend to get hurt more often than not,
so Forestier's medicinal herbs being so effective is a lifesaver.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【フォレスティエ】の薬草は治りが良くて助かるよ。
うちは怪我する子が多いから。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. That's great to hear!
We really appreciate all the
delicious food and stuff you give us, too. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへー、
そう言ってもらえてるならよかった！
こちらこそ、
いつも美味しいものをたくさんありがとう♪

text_block_list.name: Menagerie Staff
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much everyone loves the produce from Elizabeth Park.
Speaking of which, I hear Shiori's been working real hard lately.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】の乳製品はどこへ出しても好評だからね。
そういえば最近はシオリも、
色んな仕事を頑張ってるみたいよ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Really?
text_block_list.orig_text: シオリンが？

text_block_list.name: Menagerie Staff
text_block_list.text:
Seems like she's big on the idea of repaying
everyone that's helped her. Even Mahiru had
nothing but praise for her work ethic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お世話になってるみんなへ恩返しがしたいからって。
マヒルも、
『あの子は働き者だべ』って褒めてたよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Ehehe. That's my Shiorin, all right.
...Oh! I just had a super good idea! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっかぁ……
シオリンが……
えへへ。
……
そうだ！
　いいこと思いついちゃった♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wa-ha-ha!
And on that note,
it's time to go find the perfect present for Shiorin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふー！
　
よーし、
シオリンへのプレゼント探し、
開始だー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
My adorable little sister's working hard,
so its only right that I get her something she'll love! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんとして、
頑張ってる可愛い妹に
いい感じのプレゼントを選んじゃうよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But what oh what should I get her? ♪
If there's one thing she loves, it's a nice old book.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なににしよっかな～♪
シオリンの好きなものっていったら、
やっぱり本だよね～？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
She's already got stacks of them, though.
And I don't wanna get her one she wouldn't even enjoy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもでも、
本はたくさん持ってるだろうし、
シオリンの趣味に合わなかったら嫌だし……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hm... There's gotta be something that makes me go \"jackpot!\".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～……
なんかビビっとくるようなプレゼントがあればなぁ～……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: What're you doing, Hatsune?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん。
なにしてるの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
WAHHH! Sh-Shiorin?!
What're [i]you[/i] doing here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあああ！
　シ、シオリン！？
なんでここに！？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I'm on a shopping run with the rest of Elizabeth Park.
Then I heard your voice, so... 
Sorry. Am I being a bother?
text_block_list.orig_text:
牧場のみんなと買い物に来たんだけど……
そしたらお姉ちゃんの声が聞こえて……
声、かけちゃダメだった？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Of course not! Have you been staying well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメなわけないじゃん！
　
元気にしてた？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I have. I'm feeling good more often than not these days,
and I haven't had as many dizzy spells either.
Maybe it's because of the cleaner air at Elizabeth Park?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
牧場の空気がいいからかな？
　体調が良い日も増えたし、
最近はあんまり
ふら～ってしないよ。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Oh... My head...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ……
めまいが……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Shiorin!
text_block_list.orig_text: シオリーン！！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's been a while since I travelled this far out.
I think all the exertion finally caught up to me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぅ……
久々に遠出したからかな？
ふらふら～
ってしちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: A-are you okay?! Uhhh, where's the nearest hospital?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、大丈夫！？
　ええ～っと
近くの病院は～！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Please don't worry. I'm fine now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよ。
もう
平気だから。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh... W-well, if you say so...
Just don't push yourself too hard, you hear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うー、
そ、
それならいいんだけど……
無理はしちゃダメだからね！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thank you.
What were you doing, by the way?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
ありがとう。
お姉ちゃんはなにしてたの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Me? Well! I was here on super duper important business with the
Menagerie. ☆ And then I heard all about you, Shiorin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私？　
私はねー、
【動物苑】との交易品の取引に来てたのだー☆
それでねそれでね、
シオリンのこと聞いたよ～！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: About me?
text_block_list.orig_text: 私のこと？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Yuppity! Heard you're working real hard at Elizabeth Park!
That made all happy and proud! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　最近シオリンが牧場のお仕事を頑張ってるって！
それを聞いて、
すっごく嬉しくなっちゃった～♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: And then I thought, what if I—
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからね！
　そんなシオリンに……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I was gonna ask her if there's anything she wants,
but this is best off left as a surprise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……シオリンに欲しいもの聞こうと思ったけど……
……やっぱりこういうのはサプライズの方がいいよね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what if I praised you to high heavens?!
Atta girl, atta girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなシオリンを褒めてしんぜよー！
　よーしよし！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Mmghh...
text_block_list.orig_text: むぎゅ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! I gotta run home! You take care now, okay?!
And say hi to everyone at Elizabeth Park for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ私はそろそろ帰るね！
　シオリンも気を付けて帰るんだよ！？
【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】の人たちによろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: S-see ya later!
text_block_list.orig_text: そ、それじゃーねー！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Oh... Off she goes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ……
行っちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that she had something she wanted to tell me...
Oh. That's a cold breeze... Brr...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん、
私に何か言いたいことがあったんじゃ……
……あっ、風が……
あぅ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
O-oh man! Almost feels like I fled the scene of a crime!
That was super awkward of me, wasn't it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、思わず逃げてきちゃったよ～！
変だったかなぁ、
変だったよね～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Shiorin's ultra smart, too, so she probably noticed something was off!
B-but that's better than sticking around and spilling the beans!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリンは頭良いから気が付いちゃったかもー！
い、いや！
　でもあのまま話してたらもっと危なかったはず！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Anyway! I'm gonna give her a big, happy surprise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし！
　サプライズプレゼントで
シオリンをアッと驚かせちゃうぞー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Operation: Hatsune's Perfect Present starts now! ♪ Sha-shing! ☆
...Gugh. Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネちゃんのプレゼント大作戦！
いざ開始だー♪
　きらーんっ☆　
……
ぐぅ……
……
すや……すや……
